blocks.x: Okay, it's today Thursday the 25th of September. We're back at the house that Jazz built in the Bronx and we're here with Maxine Sullivan, and we're beginning the fifth session of the Oral History Interviews.
Last time we concluded talking about your period up to 1937 in Pittsburgh and there are just a few odds and ends I'd like to go back and ask you about, if you don't mind.
One thing concerns your grandparents. You talk about both grandmothers and I don't believe there was any mention of grandfathers except that your paternal grandfather was a barber.
